# The Sylvia Brafman Mental Health Center

> Comprehensive dual diagnosis mental health treatment center in South Florida offering PHP, IOP, and residential recovery programs across multiple locations.

The Sylvia Brafman Mental Health Center provides evidence-based mental health and behavioral health treatment throughout South Florida, including Fort Lauderdale, Broward County, and Palm Beach County. The center specializes in dual diagnosis treatment with five treatment lanes and operates FARR-certified recovery residences (Bloom & Lotus) for structured aftercare support.

## Key Topics

- Dual diagnosis treatment
- Mental health treatment
- Partial hospitalization program (PHP)
- Intensive outpatient program (IOP)
- Residential treatment
- Behavioral health
- Psychiatric care
- EMDR therapy
- Co-occurring disorders
- South Florida
- Broward County
- Palm Beach County
- Fort Lauderdale
- Recovery residences
- Holistic treatment approach
